source_refs.note: Topic 2.2.1.4 Input and Output Operations (PDF 36-37, printed 33-34). MCQ 4 is answered.

blocks.text: Input and output operations let a program interact with the user: it can ask the user to enter data (input) and show information to the user (output).

items: Input: input() shows a message, waits for the user to type something and press Enter, and returns the typed text, which is stored in a variable.
Output: print() takes one or more values and displays them on the screen.

blocks.title: Python code (each .... is one 4-space indent)
blocks.text:
name = input("Enter your name: ")
print("As-Salaam-Alaikum, " + name + "!")
